title: Layla and the Unlit Lantern
logline: Layla tries to give light to Sabri and learns you can only share a flame you carry.
story: Sabri, who was memory, keeper of old stories, lived in fear of the dark, and Layla, who carried observer of unseen currents, arrived with a grand offer of light. But Layla's own lantern was cold, kept only for show. However many times Layla pressed the dead lamp into Sabri's hands, no warmth would pass. Only when Layla stopped to kindle a true flame within did the smallest glow leap, at last, from one wick to the other. Layla learned that light is never given from an empty hand.
moral: You cannot give a light you have not first kindled within yourself.
